evidenceRule: Only explicit current product-body color statements supply color facts. Type selectedOptions bind those facts to the actual garment. candidates.title: Pink Horizon Family Matching Set — Dress & Shirt

sourceEvidence.quote: Moms and girls step into a flowing ombre dress that fades from blush pink through white into a coastal blue hem, while dads and boys get the coordinating short-sleeve shirt in a washed watercolor pink with the same relaxed summer mood.
